description: This file declares the interface for a class named IAVBufferHelper, which provides methods for handling buffer memory operations such as mapping, unmapping, and copying memory buffers identified by handles. It also includes a factory function to obtain an instance of the helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class providing buffer memory management functions, including mapping, unmapping, querying size, and secure data operations.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle, returning a pointer to the data and setting the size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory allocated to the handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer associated with a handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using a mapping of offsets and sizes.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
